Market today:
The mood is cautious, with bearish pressure on growth and tech. The real driver is rising Treasury yields and increasing Fed rate-hike expectations, which directly hurt your concentrated tech/chip names.

Your holdings:
SOXL (-60.26%) and SPAL (-33.64%) are both flagged as SELL. These leveraged ETFs are decaying fast, and rising rates will amplify their losses. QQQ (-0.77%) and SMH (-14.91%) are also on TRIM status, vulnerable to rate hikes. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for continued upward movement. Also, monitor any further Fed commentary for shifts in policy.

Bottom line:
Rising rates are a major headwind; manage your leveraged and concentrated tech positions carefully.
plays: Seriously consider reducing SOXL exposure. Its -60.26% loss and leveraged decay are amplified by rising rates.
Review SPAL, a leveraged SELL at -33.64%. Rising rates will increase its decay and volatility.
Consider a new buy on COP (entry 136.53-136.4, stop 136.19) as oil extends gains and offers diversification.
